title: Inside AIPF The AI Crypto Running DeFi on Polygon
description:
AIPF is a Polygon-based project claiming to be a fully AI-controlled DeFi ecosystem, where no human intervention is involved. The team has allegedly renounced ownership, leaving 5 AIs to manage supply, liquidity, staking, and sustainability forecasting.
In this video, we examine:
How “zero human control” works
The 5 AI system roles: NEE, ALS, ARP, SIG, ALP
Staking model and daily compounding mechanics
Turbo Swap release fees
Rank system and ROI-on-ROI
Sustainability and long-term viability
This is an independent analysis — not a promotion or financial advice.

asr.full_text: Intro Alright guys, so today I want to share something interesting that I randomly came across while doing my daily crypto research I was scrolling through cryptonews on investing.com, checking some updates and press releases and suddenly I noticed an article talking about a project called AI-PF. The title immediately caught my attention because it mentioned a fully-renounced decentralized finance protocol, so naturally I clicked on the article and started reading through it. And I have to say, some of the things mentioned there are actually pretty impressive. According to the article, AIPF stands for AI-Powered Finance and the goal of this... project is to create a decentralized financial ecosystem where the protocol operates automatically without human control." Now, if you've been in crypto for a while, you probably know that many projects claim to be decentralized, but developers still keep control over the smart contract. That means they can change parameters, modify modify fees or sometimes even control liquidity. But in the case of AIPF, the article clearly explains that the ownership of the smart contract has been completely renounced. That means the ownership was sent to the 0x0x0 address which basically means no developer, no admin wallet and no centralized authority has control over the contract anymore. Once it was deployed and renounced the system became completely autonomous. No one can modify the rules. No one can change the supply mechanics. And no one can alter how the protocol functions. Everything is locked into the blockchain. Now another thing that really stood out to me while reading the article is the concept behind the protocol. AIPF integrates AI-driven logic into DeFi mechanics, meaning certain processes like emissions and treasury decisions are guided by algorithmic models rather than human decisions. The system is designed to monitor treasury conditions, manage emissions responsibly and maintain sustainability within the ecosystem. In simple words, the protocol aims to remove emotional decisions from financial systems and replace them with data-driven logic. And honestly, that concept alone makes it stand out compared to many traditional DeFi tokens. But after reading the article, I didn't just stop there. I went to check some onchain analytics tools to see what the data actually looks like, and this is where things got really interesting. When I opened dex tools, I noticed that AIPF is currently trending at the number one position, that means the project is ganing a lot of attention from traders and the DeFi community. Then I check the contract on tokensnifer, and surprisingly, the token currently has a perfect 100 out of 100 score. If you know tokensnifer, you know getting a perfect 100 out of... 100 score. If you know Token Sniffer, you know getting a perfect score is not very common, because the platform checks multiple risk factors including contract structure and token mechanics. Another major point is the liquidity. According to the data, 100% of the liquidity has been burned, meaning the liquidity cannot be removed by developers. This significantly reduces the risk of liquidity manipulation or rug pulls, which is something investors always look at when evaluating a new project. So when you combine all of these factors together, renounced ownership, 100% burned liquidity, strong contracts security score, AI-based protocol logic and the fact that the token is already trending on Dex tools, it's easy to see why this project is starting to gain attention. On top of that, the ecosystem also includes staking opportunities, allowing holders to potentially earn rewards while participating in the protocol. Of course, as always in crypto, nothing is guaranteed and everyone should always do their own research before making any decisions. But if you want to check it out yourself, you can easily verify everything through tools like DexScreener, DexTools, and TokenSniffer. Sometimes the most interesting projects appear quietly in the news before the majority of the market discovers them, and AIPF might just be one of those projects worth keeping an eye on.
